keyMappings:
# Insert your preferred key mappings here.
# unmap ?
# unmap /

unmap u
unmap `

map g? showHelp
# Was 'view source' lol...
unmap gs

map : Vomnibar.activate

unmap T
map t Vomnibar.activateTabSelection
# This is mostly habit honestly.
map b Vomnibar.activateTabSelection

map T Vomnibar.activateInNewTab

# This is a lowercase L not an uppercase i.
map <c-l> Vomnibar.activateEditUrl

# We remove this in favor of general tab switcher - Use o | O if wanting bookmarks
# map b Vomnibar.activateBookmarks
map B Vomnibar.activateBookmarksInNewTab


map ` passNextKey

map u restoreTab
map gr restoreTab

unmap d
map d removeTab

unmap zi
unmap zo
unmap zz
map zi zoomIn
map zo zoomOut
map zz zoomReset


unmap <a-m>
map <c-m> toggleMuteTab
map <c-M> toggleMuteTab all


# unmap r
# map R reload
# unmap <c-r> ## THIS IS HANDLED BY ALL BROWSERS ANYWAAY!

# map r reload
map R reload hard


# Pinning
unmap <a-p>
map gp togglePinTab


unmap J
map J nextTab

unmap K
map K previousTab

unmap H
map H goBack

unmap L
map L goForward

map ' Marks.activateGotoMode

map yi duplicateTab
map g^ firstTab

map <c-o> goBack
# this is a capital i not a lowercase L
map <c-i> goForward

map <c-d> scrollPageDown
map <c-u> scrollPageUp

map <c-b> scrollFullPageDown
map <c-f> scrollFullPageUp
